host_scope: user-authorized Windows workstation; two sequential repository-owned disposable Win32 fixture processes
python_runtime: Python 3.13.14 (required by bounded AppServer pipe client on Windows)
procedure: Run the R09 held-SHIFT blocked-producer recovery gate under Python 3.13.14. Only after its bounded recovery and same-generation native UP readback pass, retire the old fixture/session. Refuse the old generation on a new fixture before input. Capture a fresh public observation of the new fixture and pass its image to one AppServer model decision. Before input, obtain a new public observation and require its generation to match the model-grounding generation. Use the model-selected point for exactly one standard compiled caller action; type only office and save only in the disposable fixture. Require retained action release, neutral native readback, fresh post-action observation, exact event/effect, and independent task oracle bound to exact call/operation/generation. Preserve the first outcome; no replay.

task.instruction: From the supplied screenshot of the owned fixture window, choose one point inside the fixture client area, within x=24..300 and y=24..150, that safely marks the fixture as clicked. Return only integer x and y. The caller will type the fixed harmless word office and save only inside the fixture process.

required_checks: phase-1 real SHIFT-down witness, one public cancel, bounded retained recovery and same-generation native key-up
old fixture retired before a fresh distinct process and target generation start
old-generation public probe refused before any task input
exactly one fresh public observation image is consumed by one real AppServer model turn
AppServer usage matches the adapter's retained protocol-journal usage and coordinate stays in frozen bounds
first standard compiled-caller observation after model completion preserves the model-grounded target generation
exactly one standard compiled action uses the returned coordinate and confirms release
independent native readback finds tracked keys and button up
fresh post-dispatch observation follows action response; fixture effect and event sequence match exactly
independent task oracle verifies exact call, operation, oracle and fresh generation
both fixtures and AppServer close cleanly, original foreground restores, and raw/pretrial hashes reconcile
limits: The blocked callable is held before native SendInput; this is not an OS/kernel SendInput hang or arbitrary-I/O guarantee.
One real AppServer decision can qualify only one owned fixture action; no production application, MAP01, or reliability-rate claim.
AppServer usage is its reported last-turn usage joined to the retained protocol journal; this is not independent upstream billing evidence, and image-input token accounting may be unavailable.
No WSLc allocation or Docker operation is used.
